questions.q: What is the fundamental difference between mass and weight?

Mass is a vector quantity measured in Newtons, while weight is a scalar quantity measured in kilograms.
Weight depends only on the speed of the object, while mass depends on its volume.
There is no difference; mass and weight are identical physical quantities.

Its mass triples due to lack of air.
Its mass converts entirely into energy.
